Frameworks for each of our studies. Each project is also outlined on the map - click its boundary to visit it.
Flora of the Saanich PeninsulaAn analysis of the vascular plant flora of the Saanich Peninsula, drawing on historical collections and community science observations to map the status of the region’s plants, track species that have not been reported in recent decades, and recognise the contributors whose records make this work possible. Átl’ḵa7tsem/Howe Sound Biosphere Vegetation ReportA map-based report on the vascular plant diversity of the Átl’ḵa7tsem/Howe Sound Biosphere Region, relating historical and community science records to biogeoclimatic zones and protected areas across the biosphere. Protocol for the Detection of ExtirpationA protocol for detecting local extinction, or extirpation, developed on Galiano Island. It combines historical specimens, community science observations and targeted searches, weighing the search effort spent in each species' historical and potential habitat to test the hypothesis that a population has been lost, in line with IUCN extinction criteria. Published in Plants, People, Planet. In development Galiano Island PPP study Galiano Island conservation analysis Hunterston Farms BioBlitz assessment ❓ Projects are still in active development.
